verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל אֹתִ֨י שָׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ לִמְשָׁחֳךָ֣ לְמֶ֔לֶךְ עַל־ עַמּ֖וֹ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְעַתָּ֣ה שְׁמַ֔ע לְק֖וֹל דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl ’ō·ṯî šā·laḥ Yah·weh lim·šā·ḥo·ḵā lə·me·leḵ ‘al- ‘am·mōw ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘ lə·qō·wl diḇ·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Samuel said to Saul The LORD sent me to anoint you king over His people . . . Israel Now therefore listen . . . to the words of the LORD
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO disse Samuel a Saul: Enviou-me o SENHOR a ungir-te rei sobre o seu povo, sobre Israel; ouve, pois, agora a voz das palavras do SENHOR.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת פָּקַ֕דְתִּי אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה עֲמָלֵ֖ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֥ם לוֹ֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ בַּעֲלֹת֖וֹ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ pā·qaḏ·tî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ‘ă·mā·lêq lə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- śām lōw bad·de·reḵ ba·‘ă·lō·ṯōw mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says I witnessed what the Amalekites did to the Israelites when they opposed them on their way up from Egypt
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Eu me recordei do que fez Amaleque a Israel; como se lhe opôs no caminho, quando subia do Egito.

verses.original: עַתָּה֩ לֵ֨ךְ וְהִכִּֽיתָ֜ה אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֗ק וְהַֽחֲרַמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ל עָלָ֑יו וְהֵמַתָּ֞ה מֵאִ֣ישׁ עַד־ אִשָּׁ֗ה מֵֽעֹלֵל֙ וְעַד־ יוֹנֵ֔ק מִשּׁ֣וֹר וְעַד־ שֶׂ֔ה מִגָּמָ֖ל וְעַד־ חֲמֽוֹר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh lêḵ wə·hik·kî·ṯāh ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq wə·ha·ḥă·ram·tem ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw wə·lō ṯaḥ·mōl ‘ā·lāw wə·hê·mat·tāh mê·’îš ‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh mê·‘ō·lêl wə·‘aḏ- yō·w·nêq miš·šō·wr wə·‘aḏ- śeh mig·gā·māl wə·‘aḏ- ḥă·mō·wr
verses.literal: Now go and attack the Amalekites and devote to destruction all that belongs to them Do not spare them but put to death men and women children and infants oxen and sheep camels and donkeys
verses.literalPt: Vai, pois, agora e fere a Amaleque; e destrói totalmente a tudo o que tiver, e não lhe perdoes; porém matarás desde o homem até à mulher, desde os meninos até aos de peito, desde os bois até às ovelhas, e desde os camelos até aos jumentos.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁמַּ֤ע שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וַֽיִּפְקְדֵם֙ בַּטְּלָאִ֔ים מָאתַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף רַגְלִ֑י וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים אֶת־ אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·šam·ma‘ šā·’ūl ’eṯ- hā·‘ām way·yip̄·qə·ḏêm baṭ·ṭə·lā·’îm mā·ṯa·yim ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî wa·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’eṯ- ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: So Saul summoned the troops and numbered them at Telaim 200,000 . . . foot soldiers and 10,000 . . . . . . men of Judah
verses.literalPt: O que Saul convocou ao povo, e os contou em Telaim, duzentos mil homens de pé, e dez mil homens de Judá.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א שָׁא֖וּל עַד־ עִ֣יר עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיָּ֖רֶב בַּנָּֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō šā·’ūl ‘aḏ- ‘îr ‘ă·mā·lêq way·yā·reḇ ban·nā·ḥal
verses.literal: Saul came to the city of Amalek and lay in wait in the valley
verses.literalPt: Chegando, pois, Saul à cidade de Amaleque, pôs emboscada no vale.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֣וּל אֶֽל־ הַקֵּינִ֡י לְכוּ֩ סֻּ֨רוּ רְד֜וּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ עֲמָלֵקִ֗י פֶּן־ אֹֽסִפְךָ֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וְאַתָּ֞ה עָשִׂ֤יתָה חֶ֙סֶד֙ עִם־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּעֲלוֹתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיָּ֥סַר קֵינִ֖י מִתּ֥וֹךְ עֲמָלֵֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl ’el- haq·qê·nî lə·ḵū su·rū rə·ḏū mit·tō·wḵ ‘ă·mā·lê·qî pen- ’ō·sip̄·ḵā ‘im·mōw wə·’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯāh ḥe·seḏ ‘im- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ba·‘ă·lō·w·ṯām mim·miṣ·rā·yim way·yā·sar qê·nî mit·tō·wḵ ‘ă·mā·lêq
verses.literal: And he warned . . . the Kenites Since you showed kindness to all the Israelites . . . when they came up out of Egypt go on and get away from the Amalekites Otherwise I will sweep you away with them So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites
verses.literalPt: E disse Saul aos queneus: Ide-vos, retirai-vos e saí do meio dos amalequitas, para que não vos destrua juntamente com eles, porque vós usastes de misericórdia com todos os filhos de Israel, quando subiram do Egito. Assim os queneus se retiraram do meio dos amalequitas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥ךְ שָׁא֖וּל אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֑ק מֵֽחֲוִילָה֙ בּוֹאֲךָ֣ שׁ֔וּר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ šā·’ūl ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq mê·ḥă·wî·lāh bō·w·’ă·ḵā šūr ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then Saul struck down the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur which is east of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Então feriu Saul aos amalequitas desde Havilá até chegar a Sur, que está defronte do Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּתְפֹּ֛שׂ אֶת־ אֲגַ֥ג מֶֽלֶךְ־ עֲמָלֵ֖ק חָ֑י וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם הֶחֱרִ֥ים לְפִי־ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·pōś ’eṯ- ’ă·ḡaḡ me·leḵ- ‘ă·mā·lêq ḥāy wə·’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām he·ḥĕ·rîm lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: He captured Agag king of Amalek alive but devoted . . . all the others to destruction with the sword
verses.literalPt: E tomou vivo a Agague, rei dos amalequitas; porém a todo o povo destruiu ao fio da espada.

verses.original: וַיַּחְמֹל֩ שָׁא֨וּל וְהָעָ֜ם עַל־ אֲגָ֗ג וְעַל־ מֵיטַ֣ב הַצֹּאן֩ וְהַבָּקָ֨ר וְהַמִּשְׁנִ֤ים וְעַל־ הַכָּרִים֙ וְעַל־ כָּל־ הַטּ֔וֹב וְלֹ֥א אָב֖וּ הַחֲרִימָ֑ם וְכָל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֛ה נְמִבְזָ֥ה וְנָמֵ֖ס אֹתָ֥הּ הֶחֱרִֽימוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·mōl šā·’ūl wə·hā·‘ām ‘al- ’ă·ḡāḡ wə·‘al- mê·ṭaḇ haṣ·ṣōn wə·hab·bā·qār wə·ham·miš·nîm wə·‘al- hak·kā·rîm wə·‘al- kāl- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·lō ’ā·ḇū ha·ḥă·rî·mām wə·ḵāl ham·mə·lā·ḵāh nə·miḇ·zāh wə·nā·mês ’ō·ṯāh he·ḥĕ·rî·mū
verses.literal: Saul and his troops . . . spared Agag along with the best of the sheep and cattle the fat calves and lambs and the best of everything else They were unwilling to devote them to destruction but they devoted to destruction all that was despised and worthless
verses.literalPt: E Saul e o povo pouparam a Agague, e ao melhor das ovelhas e das vacas, e as da segunda ordem, e aos cordeiros e ao melhor que havia, e não os quiseram destruir totalmente; porém a toda a coisa vil e desprezível destruíram totalmente.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- šə·mū·’êl lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Samuel saying
verses.literalPt: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Samuel, dizendo:

verses.original: נִחַ֗מְתִּי כִּֽי־ הִמְלַ֤כְתִּי אֶת־ שָׁאוּל֙ לְמֶ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי־ שָׁב֙ מֵאַֽחֲרַ֔י וְאֶת־ דְּבָרַ֖י לֹ֣א הֵקִ֑ים וַיִּ֙חַר֙ לִשְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיִּזְעַ֥ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ni·ḥam·tî kî- him·laḵ·tî ’eṯ- šā·’ūl lə·me·leḵ kî- šāḇ mê·’a·ḥă·ray wə·’eṯ- də·ḇā·ray lō hê·qîm way·yi·ḥar liš·mū·’êl way·yiz·‘aq ’el- Yah·weh kāl- hal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: I regret that I have made Saul king - for he has turned away from following Me and has not carried out My instructions And Samuel was distressed and cried out to the LORD all that night
verses.literalPt: Arrependo-me de haver posto a Saul como rei; porquanto deixou de me seguir, e não cumpriu as minhas palavras. Então Samuel se contristou, e toda a noite clamou ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֧ם שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל לִקְרַ֥את שָׁא֖וּל בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיֻּגַּ֨ד לִשְׁמוּאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר בָּֽא־ שָׁא֤וּל הַכַּרְמֶ֙לָה֙ וְהִנֵּ֨ה מַצִּ֥יב לוֹ֙ יָ֔ד וַיִּסֹּב֙ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֔ר וַיֵּ֖רֶד הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm šə·mū·’êl liq·raṯ šā·’ūl bab·bō·qer way·yug·gaḏ liš·mū·’êl lê·mōr bā- šā·’ūl hak·kar·me·lāh wə·hin·nêh maṣ·ṣîḇ lōw yāḏ way·yis·sōḇ way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr way·yê·reḏ hag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: Early in the morning Samuel got up to confront Saul but he was told . . . . . . Saul has gone to Carmel and behold he has set up a monument for himself and has turned . . . and gone down to Gilgal
verses.literalPt: E madrugou Samuel para encontrar a Saul pela manhã: e anunciou-se a Samuel, dizendo: Já chegou Saul ao Carmelo, e eis que levantou para si uma coluna. Então voltando, passou e desceu a Gilgal.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־ שָׁא֑וּל וַיֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ שָׁא֗וּל בָּר֤וּךְ אַתָּה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה הֲקִימֹ֖תִי אֶת־ דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl way·yō·mer lōw šā·’ūl bā·rūḵ ’at·tāh Yah·weh hă·qî·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Samuel reached . . . him Saul said to him May the LORD bless you I have carried out the LORD’s instructions
verses.literalPt: Veio, pois, Samuel a Saul; e Saul lhe disse: Bendito sejas tu do SENHOR; cumpri a palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וּמֶ֛ה קֽוֹל־ הַצֹּ֥אן הַזֶּ֖ה בְּאָזְנָ֑י וְק֣וֹל הַבָּקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ū·meh qō·wl- haṣ·ṣōn haz·zeh bə·’ā·zə·nāy wə·qō·wl hab·bā·qār ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·mê·a‘
verses.literal: But Samuel replied Then what is this bleating of sheep and lowing of cattle that I hear
verses.literalPt: Então disse Samuel: Que balido, pois, de ovelhas é este aos meus ouvidos, e o mugido de vacas que ouço?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל מֵעֲמָלֵקִ֣י הֱבִיא֗וּם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָמַ֤ל הָעָם֙ עַל־ מֵיטַ֤ב הַצֹּאן֙ וְהַבָּקָ֔ר לְמַ֥עַן זְבֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְאֶת־ הַיּוֹתֵ֖ר הֶחֱרַֽמְנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl mê·‘ă·mā·lê·qî hĕ·ḇî·’ūm ’ă·šer ḥā·mal hā·‘ām ‘al- mê·ṭaḇ haṣ·ṣōn wə·hab·bā·qār lə·ma·‘an zə·ḇō·aḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·’eṯ- hay·yō·w·ṯêr he·ḥĕ·ram·nū
verses.literal: Saul answered The troops . . . brought them from the Amalekites they spared the best sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the LORD your God but the rest we devoted to destruction
verses.literalPt: E disse Saul: De Amaleque as trouxeram; porque o povo poupou ao melhor das ovelhas, e das vacas, para as oferecer ao SENHOR teu Deus; o resto, porém, temos destruído totalmente.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל הֶ֚רֶף וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לְּךָ֔ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י הַלָּ֑יְלָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ ל֖וֹ דַּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl he·rep̄ wə·’ag·gî·ḏāh lə·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’ê·lay hal·lā·yə·lāh way·yō·mə·rū lōw dab·bêr
verses.literal: Stop exclaimed Samuel - Let me tell you what the LORD said to me last night Tell me Saul replied
verses.literalPt: Então disse Samuel a Saul: Espera, e te declararei o que o SENHOR me disse esta noite. E ele disse-lhe: Fala.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הֲל֗וֹא אִם־ קָטֹ֤ן אַתָּה֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ רֹ֛אשׁ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אָ֑תָּה וַיִּמְשָׁחֲךָ֧ יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl hă·lō·w ’im- qā·ṭōn ’at·tāh bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā rōš šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ’āt·tāh way·yim·šā·ḥă·ḵā Yah·weh lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And Samuel said Although you were once small in your own eyes have you not become the head of the tribes of Israel The LORD anointed you king over Israel
verses.literalPt: E disse Samuel: Porventura, sendo tu pequeno aos teus olhos, não foste por cabeça das tribos de Israel? E o SENHOR te ungiu rei sobre Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלָחֲךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בְּדָ֑רֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ וְהַחֲרַמְתָּ֞ה אֶת־ הַֽחַטָּאִים֙ אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְנִלְחַמְתָּ֣ ב֔וֹ עַ֥ד כַּלּוֹתָ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lā·ḥă·ḵā Yah·weh bə·ḏā·reḵ way·yō·mer lêḵ wə·ha·ḥă·ram·tāh ’eṯ- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq wə·nil·ḥam·tā ḇōw ‘aḏ kal·lō·w·ṯām ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: and sent . . . you on a mission saying Go and devote to destruction the sinful Amalekites Fight against them until you have wiped them out
verses.literalPt: E enviou-te o SENHOR a este caminho, e disse: Vai, e destrói totalmente a estes pecadores, os amalequitas, e peleja contra eles, até que os aniquiles.

verses.original: וְלָ֥מָּה לֹא־ שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַתַּ֙עַט֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׁלָ֔ל וַתַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lām·māh lō- šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh wat·ta·‘aṭ ’el- haš·šā·lāl wat·ta·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So why did you not obey . . . the LORD Why did you rush upon the plunder and do evil in the sight of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Por que, pois, não deste ouvidos à voz do SENHOR, antes te lançaste ao despojo, e fizeste o que parecia mau aos olhos do SENHOR?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וָאֵלֵ֕ךְ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי יְהוָ֑ה וָאָבִ֗יא אֶת־ אֲגַג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְאֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֖ק הֶחֱרַֽמְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl ’el- šə·mū·’êl ’ă·šer šā·ma‘·tî bə·qō·wl Yah·weh wā·’ê·lêḵ bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer- šə·lā·ḥa·nî Yah·weh wā·’ā·ḇî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḡaḡ me·leḵ ‘ă·mā·lêq wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq he·ḥĕ·ram·tî
verses.literal: But I did obey . . . the LORD Saul - replied I went on the mission that the LORD gave me I brought back Agag king of Amalek and devoted the Amalekites to destruction
verses.literalPt: Então disse Saul a Samuel: Antes dei ouvidos à voz do SENHOR, e caminhei no caminho pelo qual o SENHOR me enviou; e trouxe a Agague, rei de Amaleque, e os amalequitas destruí totalmente;

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח הָעָ֧ם מֵהַשָּׁלָ֛ל צֹ֥אן וּבָקָ֖ר רֵאשִׁ֣ית הַחֵ֑רֶם לִזְבֹּ֛חַ לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ hā·‘ām mê·haš·šā·lāl ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār rê·šîṯ ha·ḥê·rem liz·bō·aḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: The troops took sheep and cattle from the plunder the best of the things devoted to destruction in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God at Gilgal
verses.literalPt: Mas o povo tomou do despojo ovelhas e vacas, o melhor do interdito, para oferecer ao SENHOR teu Deus em Gilgal.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הַחֵ֤פֶץ לַֽיהוָה֙ בְּעֹל֣וֹת וּזְבָחִ֔ים כִּשְׁמֹ֖עַ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֤ה שְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ מִזֶּ֣בַח ט֔וֹב לְהַקְשִׁ֖יב מֵחֵ֥לֶב אֵילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ha·ḥê·p̄eṣ Yah·weh bə·‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·zə·ḇā·ḥîm kiš·mō·a‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh hin·nêh šə·mō·a‘ miz·ze·ḇaḥ ṭō·wḇ lə·haq·šîḇ mê·ḥê·leḇ ’ê·lîm
verses.literal: But Samuel declared Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice . . . Behold obedience is better than sacrifice and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams
verses.literalPt: Porém Samuel disse: Tem porventura o SENHOR tanto prazer em holocaustos e sacrifícios, como em que se obedeça à palavra do SENHOR? Eis que o obedecer é melhor do que o sacrificar; e o atender melhor é do que a gordura de carneiros.

verses.original: כִּ֤י חַטַּאת־ קֶ֙סֶם֙ מֶ֔רִי וְאָ֥וֶן וּתְרָפִ֖ים הַפְצַ֑ר יַ֗עַן מָאַ֙סְתָּ֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ֖ מִמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ- qe·sem me·rî wə·’ā·wen ū·ṯə·rā·p̄îm hap̄·ṣar ya·‘an mā·’as·tā ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh way·yim·’ā·sə·ḵā mim·me·leḵ
verses.literal: For rebellion is like the sin of divination and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry Because you have rejected the word of the LORD He has rejected you as king
verses.literalPt: Porque a rebelião é como o pecado de feitiçaria, e o porfiar é como iniqüidade e idolatria. Porquanto tu rejeitaste a palavra do SENHOR, ele também te rejeitou a ti, para que não sejas rei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֤וּל אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵל֙ חָטָ֔אתִי כִּֽי־ עָבַ֥רְתִּי אֶת־ פִּֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ דְּבָרֶ֑יךָ כִּ֤י יָרֵ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע בְּקוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl ’el- šə·mū·’êl ḥā·ṭā·ṯî kî- ‘ā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- pî- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- də·ḇā·re·ḵā kî yā·rê·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wā·’eš·ma‘ bə·qō·w·lām
verses.literal: Then Saul said to Samuel I have sinned I have transgressed the LORD’s commandment and your instructions because I feared the people and obeyed their voice
verses.literalPt: Então disse Saul a Samuel: Pequei, porquanto tenho transgredido a ordem do SENHOR e as tuas palavras; porque temi ao povo, e dei ouvidos à sua voz.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה שָׂ֥א נָ֖א אֶת־ חַטָּאתִ֑י וְשׁ֣וּב עִמִּ֔י וְאֶֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh śā nā ’eṯ- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî wə·šūḇ ‘im·mî wə·’eš·ta·ḥă·weh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now therefore please forgive my sin and return with me so I can worship the LORD
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, rogo-te perdoa o meu pecado; e volta comigo, para que adore ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל לֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עִמָּ֑ךְ כִּ֤י מָאַ֙סְתָּה֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה מִהְי֥וֹת מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl lō ’ā·šūḇ ‘im·māḵ kî mā·’as·tāh ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh way·yim·’ā·sə·ḵā Yah·weh mih·yō·wṯ me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I will not return with you Samuel replied - For you have rejected the word of the LORD and He has rejected you as king over Israel
verses.literalPt: Porém Samuel disse a Saul: Não voltarei contigo; porquanto rejeitaste a palavra do SENHOR, já te rejeitou o SENHOR, para que não sejas rei sobre Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּסֹּ֥ב שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל לָלֶ֑כֶת וַיַּחֲזֵ֥ק בִּכְנַף־ מְעִיל֖וֹ וַיִּקָּרַֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sōḇ šə·mū·’êl lā·le·ḵeṯ way·ya·ḥă·zêq biḵ·nap̄- mə·‘î·lōw way·yiq·qā·ra‘
verses.literal: As Samuel turned to go Saul grabbed the hem of his robe and it tore
verses.literalPt: E virando-se Samuel para se ir, ele lhe pegou pela orla da capa, e a rasgou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל קָרַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽת־ מַמְלְכ֧וּת יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵעָלֶ֖יךָ הַיּ֑וֹם וּנְתָנָ֕הּ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ הַטּ֥וֹב מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw šə·mū·’êl qā·ra‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- mam·lə·ḵūṯ yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ā·le·ḵā hay·yō·wm ū·nə·ṯā·nāh lə·rê·‘ă·ḵā haṭ·ṭō·wḇ mim·me·kā
verses.literal: So Samuel said to him The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to your neighbor who is better than you
verses.literalPt: Então Samuel lhe disse: O SENHOR tem rasgado de ti hoje o reino de Israel, e o tem dado ao teu próximo, melhor do que tu.

verses.original: וְגַם֙ נֵ֣צַח יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יְשַׁקֵּ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִנָּחֵ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א אָדָ֛ם ה֖וּא לְהִנָּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam nê·ṣaḥ yiś·rā·’êl lō yə·šaq·qêr wə·lō yin·nā·ḥêm kî lō ’ā·ḏām hū lə·hin·nā·ḥêm
verses.literal: Moreover the Glory of Israel does not lie or change His mind for . . . He is not a man that He should change His mind
verses.literalPt: E também aquele que é a Força de Israel não mente nem se arrepende; porquanto não é um homem para que se arrependa.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חָטָ֔אתִי עַתָּ֗ה כַּבְּדֵ֥נִי נָ֛א נֶ֥גֶד זִקְנֵֽי־ עַמִּ֖י וְנֶ֣גֶד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשׁ֣וּב עִמִּ֔י וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֵ֖יתִי לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥā·ṭā·ṯî ‘at·tāh kab·bə·ḏê·nî nā ne·ḡeḏ ziq·nê- ‘am·mî wə·ne·ḡeḏ yiś·rā·’êl wə·šūḇ ‘im·mî wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wê·ṯî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: I have sinned Saul replied Please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel Come back with me so that I may worship the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Disse ele então: Pequei; honra-me, porém, agora diante dos anciãos do meu povo, e diante de Israel; e volta comigo, para que adore ao SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שָׁב שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ שָׁא֖וּל לַֽיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ šə·mū·’êl ’a·ḥă·rê šā·’ūl way·yiš·ta·ḥū šā·’ūl Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Samuel went back with Saul and Saul worshiped the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então, voltando Samuel, seguiu a Saul; e Saul adorou ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הַגִּ֤ישׁוּ אֵלַי֙ אֶת־ אֲגַג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֵלָ֔יו אֲגַ֖ג מַעֲדַנֹּ֑ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲגָ֔ג אָכֵ֖ן סָ֥ר מַר־ הַמָּֽוֶת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl hag·gî·šū ’ê·lay ’eṯ- ’ă·ḡaḡ me·leḵ ‘ă·mā·lêq way·yê·leḵ ’ê·lāw ’ă·ḡaḡ ma·‘ă·ḏan·nōṯ way·yō·mer ’ă·ḡāḡ ’ā·ḵên sār mar- ham·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Then Samuel said Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites Agag came to him cheerfully for he thought Surely the bitterness of death is past
verses.literalPt: Então disse Samuel: Trazei-me aqui a Agague, rei dos amalequitas. E Agague veio a ele animosamente; e disse Agague: Na verdade já passou a amargura da morte.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכְּלָ֤ה נָשִׁים֙ חַרְבֶּ֔ךָ כֵּן־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ל מִנָּשִׁ֖ים אִמֶּ֑ךָ וַיְשַׁסֵּ֨ף שְׁמוּאֵ֧ל אֶת־ אֲגָ֛ג לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ka·’ă·šer šik·kə·lāh nā·šîm ḥar·be·ḵā kên- tiš·kal min·nā·šîm ’im·me·ḵā way·šas·sêp̄ šə·mū·’êl ’eṯ- ’ă·ḡāḡ lip̄·nê Yah·weh bag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: But Samuel declared As your sword has made women childless so your mother will be childless among women And Samuel hacked Agag to pieces before the LORD at Gilgal
verses.literalPt: Disse, porém, Samuel: Assim como a tua espada desfilhou as mulheres, assim ficará desfilhada a tua mãe entre as mulheres. Então Samuel despedaçou a Agague perante o SENHOR em Gilgal.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הָרָמָ֑תָה וְשָׁא֛וּל עָלָ֥ה אֶל־ בֵּית֖וֹ גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ šə·mū·’êl hā·rā·mā·ṯāh wə·šā·’ūl ‘ā·lāh ’el- bê·ṯōw giḇ·‘aṯ šā·’ūl
verses.literal: Then Samuel went to Ramah but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul
verses.literalPt: Então Samuel se foi a Ramá; e Saul subiu à sua casa, a Gibeá de Saul.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ יָסַ֨ף שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל לִרְא֤וֹת אֶת־ שָׁאוּל֙ עַד־ י֣וֹם מוֹת֔וֹ כִּֽי־ הִתְאַבֵּ֥ל שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־ שָׁא֑וּל וַיהוָ֣ה נִחָ֔ם כִּֽי־ הִמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ שָׁא֖וּל עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·sap̄ šə·mū·’êl lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- šā·’ūl ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·w·ṯōw kî- hiṯ·’ab·bêl šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl Yah·weh ni·ḥām kî- him·lîḵ ’eṯ- šā·’ūl ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And to the day of his death . . . Samuel never again visited Saul Samuel mourned for Saul and the LORD regretted that He had made Saul king over Israel
verses.literalPt: E nunca mais viu Samuel a Saul até ao dia da sua morte; porque Samuel teve dó de Saul. E o SENHOR se arrependeu de haver posto a Saul rei sobre Israel.
